text: Rebase note (worker3): my branch commit b9dca9fc83 was dropped during rebase onto main because f93406d4be 'fix(rust): clear lichen-core clippy -D warnings' (landed 2026-09-08 15:00 PDT, before my session) already cleared the same 35 warnings in the same 6 files with equivalent rewrites.
